{{Short description|Computational complexity class}}
In [[computational complexity theory]], the [[complexity class]] '''NE''' is the set of [[Decision problem|decision problems]] that can be solved by a [[non-deterministic Turing machine]] in time <math>2^{O(n)}
</math>.<ref>{{ComplexityZoo|NE|N#ne}}</ref> It is similar to '''[[NEXPTIME]]''', the set of decision problems that can be solved by a non-deterministic Turing machine in time <math>2^{n^O(1)}
</math>. By definition, it is contained in '''NEXPTIME'''.

'''NE''', unlike '''[[NEXPTIME]]''', is not closed under [[Polynomial-time reduction|polynomial-time]] [[many-one reduction]]s.
